slices.focus: Nadia's intake huddles and shared 30-day checklist get official pilot approval after she presents timing data.
slices.summary: Nadia's director approves a pilot program for twice-weekly intake huddles and a shared 30-day checklist for new families. She won approval by presenting six weeks of handwritten timing notes and overdue-task counts rather than emotional appeals. The pilot focuses on the highest-risk first month. Nadia plans to keep huddles to 20 minutes, track overdue items and blockers, and end each huddle with a lightweight feedback prompt.
open_loops: Run first two huddles with tight agenda
Track overdue items and whether huddles catch early blockers
End each huddle with 'what's helping / what's wasting time' prompt
Prove consistency over impressiveness in first weeks
